parts.text: 我会另算一个仅用于诊断的“排除图标区域”相似度，帮助判断剩余差距是否来自背景、文字或位置；正式总体分数仍按原 E2E 全图口径报告。

tool_input.request: 执行一次只读像素对比：比较 e2e/home-v2/fixtures/navbar-reference.png 与 e2e/artifacts/task2468-navbar-visual/navbar-visual-1920.png，沿用 pixelmatch threshold 0.1、includeAA false；另计算排除菜单图标、箭头与用户头像矩形区域后的诊断相似度。不得修改文件。

args: const fs=require('fs'); const {PNG}=require('pngjs'); const pixelmatch=require('pixelmatch'); const ref=PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync('e2e/home-v2/fixtures/navbar-reference.png')); const act=PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync('e2e/artifacts/task2468-navbar-visual/navbar-visual-1920.png')); const w=ref.width,h=ref.height; if(w!==act.width||h!==act.height) throw Error('dimension mismatch'); const boxes=[[494,24,38,34],[634,24,38,34],[750,24,38,34],[871,24,38,34],[997,24,38,34],[1127,24,38,34],[1256,24,38,34],[1385,24,38,34],[1516,24,38,34],[1640,24,38,34],[1688,38,28,34],[1855,22,36,36]]; const r=Buffer.from(ref.data), a=Buffer.from(act.data); const masked=new Uint8Array(w*h); for(const [x0,y0,bw,bh] of boxes){for(let y=Math.max(0,y0);y<Math.min(h,y0+bh);y++)for(let x=Math.max(0,x0);x<Math.min(w,x0+bw);x++){const p=y*w+x;masked[p]=1;const i=p*4;r[i]=r[i+1]=r[i+2]=r[i+3]=0;a[i]=a[i+1]=a[i+2]=a[i+3]=0;}} let maskedPixels=0; for(const v of masked) maskedPixels+=v; const total=w*h; const all=pixelmatch(ref.data,act.data,null,w,h,{threshold:0.1,includeAA:false}); const diff=pixelmatch(r,a,null,w,h,{threshold:0.1,includeAA:false}); console.log(JSON.stringify({overallSimilarity:((1-all/total)*100).toFixed(3)+'%',iconBoxesMasked:maskedPixels,nonIconSimilarity:((1-diff/(total-maskedPixels))*100).toFixed(3)+'%'},null,2));
